Be careful eating raw salmon. Far to many wild caught and farm raised salmon are not being properly flash frozen and kept frozen long enough to kill parasite that are common to salmon that are very bad for humans, especially Asian processed salmon from fly by night operations. Unless you know the source on the salmon it may be best to skip it in raw form. Basically if it is "cheap" salmon sushi skip it, sushi grade salmon cost money about $30/lbs.

Freezing is often used to kill parasites. According to European Union regulations, freezing fish at −20 °C (−4 °F) for 24 hours kills parasites. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) recommends freezing at −35 °C (−31 °F) for 15 hours, or at −20 °C (−4 °F) for 7 days. If the salmon does not meet these standards you will get parasites and not the kind your body can cope with but the kind that will make you very sick.

For further information visit here: http://www.fda.gov/Food/ResourcesForYou/Consumers/ucm077331.htm and http://www.fda.gov/downloads/Food/GuidanceRegulation/UCM252393.pdf
